newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSDOC PLANS ORDINARY/PREF SHARE ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: AUSDOC PLANS ORDINARY/PREF SHARE ISSUES.

text.p: Ausdoc Group Ltd said the A$115 million purchase of a New Zealand express freight firm would probably be financed by bank senior debt and equity, including a likely issue of ordinary shares to raise A$40 million.

The company said the share issue would consist of a renounceable rights issue and a placement while the equity component would also include an issue of about NZ$30 million of perpetual preference shares by Ausdoc's N.Z. subsidiary. Ausdoc said earlier on Thursday it would acquire the express freight services division of New Zealand company Freightways Ltd.
"The board is still reviewing the precise composition of such funding with SBC Warburg and BT Securities and will provide further details when finalised," it said.
The company did not provide any details about debt raising.

Ausdoc's planned acquisition was announced before the market opened and its shares were suspended after a few minutes of trading pending an announcement. Its shares were 10 cents higher at A$2.50 at 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT).
